templeInfo.tagline: Sanctuary of Divine Grace, Healing & Eternal Prosperity
templeInfo.location: No. 48, Sannadhi Street, Mylapore, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600004
templeInfo.history: Sri Amman Temple is an ancient sanctuary with a sacred heritage spanning over 300 years. According to local sthala puranam, a divine self-manifested (Swayambhu) trident was discovered at this consecrated site by revered temple elders. The presiding deity, Sri Maha Mariamman, is venerated as the cosmic Mother and Supreme Shakti who protects devotees, banishes ailments, blesses barren lands with monsoon rains, and grants peace and spiritual elevation. The temple follows traditional Saiva and Shakta Agamic rituals passed down through generations of devoted Sivachariyars.
templeInfo.traditions: The temple observes strict Vedic Agamic traditions. Daily rituals begin before dawn with Suprabhatam and Gho Pooja (cow worship), followed by five daily Kaala Poojas with holy thirumanjanam (sacred baths) of milk, tender coconut water, sandalwood, and turmeric. Special Rahu Kalam Deeparadhana is observed on Tuesdays and Fridays, drawing thousands of devotees offering lemon lamps to Goddess Durga.

poojaTimings.name: Ushakkala Pooja & Suprabhatam
poojaTimings.description: Temple doors open, Mangala Vadhyam, waking up of the divine Mother, Gho Pooja and Nirmalya Darshanam.

poojaTimings.name: Kaalasanthi Pooja
poojaTimings.description: Sacred milk abhishekam, floral alangaram, Naivedhyam offering, and first Maha Deeparadhana.

poojaTimings.name: Uchikkala Pooja (Midday)
poojaTimings.description: Midday grand abhishekam with panchamritam, Sahasranama Archana, and Rajagopuram bell ringing.

poojaTimings.name: Afternoon Closure
poojaTimings.description: Temple sanctum sanctorum closes for afternoon rest until evening re-opening.

poojaTimings.name: Sayaratchai Pooja (Evening)
poojaTimings.description: Temple reopens, lighting of one thousand oil lamps, Dhoop Deepam, and Veda Parayanam.

poojaTimings.name: Arthajaama Pooja & Palliyarai Seve
poojaTimings.description: Night closing ritual, sacred lullaby (Oonjal Seve), offering of hot milk and dry fruits, sanctum closure at 09:00 PM.

poojas.title: Astothara Sathanama Archana
poojas.description: Sacred recitation of 108 divine names of Sri Amman with fresh red hibiscus, vilvam, and kumkum offering for devotee and family.
poojas.benefits: Removes planetary obstacles, grants mental tranquility, and protects against evil eye.

poojas.title: Special Thirumanjana Abhishekam
poojas.description: Elaborate sacred bath with 11 holy Dravyas including fresh cow milk, tender coconut, curd, honey, panchamirtham, turmeric, and pure sandalwood paste.
poojas.benefits: Brings auspiciousness, heals long-standing health issues, and purifies family lineage.

poojas.title: Rahu Kala Durga Lemon Lamp Pooja
poojas.description: Special propitiation of Goddess Durga during Rahu Kalam with inverted lemon peel ghee lamps and red flower garlands.
poojas.benefits: Neutralizes severe Rahu-Ketu doshas, resolves marriage and career delays, and brings fierce divine protection.
poojas.availableDays: Tuesdays (3:00 PM - 4:30 PM) & Fridays (10:30 AM - 12:00 PM)

poojas.title: Maha Chandi Homam & Yagna
poojas.description: Supreme Vedic fire sacrifice invoking Devi Chandika with recitation of the Devi Mahatmyam (700 sacred mantras) and 108 medicinal herb offerings.
poojas.benefits: Vanquishes legal adversaries, dispels negative energies, and bestows overwhelming prosperity and triumph.

poojas.title: Navagraha Shanthi & Dosha Nivarana
poojas.description: Comprehensive propitiation of all nine planetary deities with their respective grains (Navadhanyam), sacred colored vastrams, and specific samidha.
poojas.benefits: Alleviates Sade Sati, Ashtama Sani, Kuja Dosha, and establishes celestial harmony.

poojas.title: Golden Chariot (Thanga Ratham) Procession
poojas.description: Devotee family is privileged to pull the magnificent Golden Chariot carrying the Utsavamurthy of Sri Amman along the illuminated inner temple corridor.
poojas.benefits: Royal honors, generation-spanning blessings, fulfilment of deep cherished vows.

poojas.title: Sahasranama Lalitha Archana
poojas.description: Chanting of the 1,000 supreme names of Sri Lalitha Tripura Sundari with kumkum archana performed directly in front of the sanctum.
poojas.benefits: Invokes the unconditional maternal compassion of the Divine Mother, brings educational excellence and wisdom.

poojas.title: Nitya Annadhanam (100 Devotees Feeding)
poojas.description: Sponsor hot, hygienic, traditional satvik meals (Sambar rice, Poriyal, Payasam, Vadai, Buttermilk) served on banana leaves to 100 pilgrims in your family name.
poojas.benefits: The highest of all Vedic karmas; wipes out negative past deeds and feeds hungry pilgrims.

festivals.title: Aadi Thiruvizha & Poochorithal
festivals.description: The sacred month of Aadi brings the temple's largest 10-day celebration. Features the majestic flag hoisting (Dwajarohanam), flower showering (Poochorithal), milk pot procession (Paal Kudam) with over 5,000 devotees, and sacred fire-walking (Thee Midhi).
schedule: Day 10: Thee Midhi Thiruvizha & Golden Chariot Ula

festivals.title: Navaratri & Vijayadasami Utsavam
festivals.description: Nine divine nights dedicated to Goddess Durga, Lakshmi, and Saraswati. The temple features a breathtaking 9-step traditional Golu display, daily classical Carnatic music concerts, and special Alankaram transforming Sri Amman each night.
schedule: Nights 7-9: Sri Saraswati & Mahishasura Mardini Alankaram

festivals.title: Panguni Uthiram Thirukkalyanam
festivals.description: Celebration of the celestial wedding of the Divine Mother. Devotees witness the divine Thirukkalyana Utsavam with traditional Mangalya Dharanam, silver palanquin procession, and mass Annadhanam.
schedule: Day 2: Maha Thirukkalyanam at Muhurtha Lagnam

festivals.title: Maha Shivaratri & Ammavasai
festivals.description: The sacred night of Lord Shiva and Devi Shakti. All-night vigils with four Kaala Abhishekam conducted at midnight, continuous Rudra Japa, Bilva archana, and divine devotional discourses.

gallery.title: The Majestic Dravidian Rajagopuram
gallery.description: The 11-tiered illuminated Gopuram soaring 145 feet with intricate Agamic terracotta sculptures depicting temple leelas.

gallery.title: Sanctum Brass Deepam & Oil Lamps
gallery.description: Auspicious brass lamps and glowing deeparadhana flame during the evening Sayaratchai offering.

gallery.title: Aadi Poochorithal Floral Offering
gallery.description: Tons of fresh jasmine, marigold, and lotus flowers offered to Sri Amman during the annual festival.

gallery.title: Sacred Gho Pooja & Temple Cow Sanctuary
gallery.description: Devotees participating in morning Gho Pooja at the temple's revered Goshala.

gallery.title: Devotees at Temple Prakaram & Sacred Pond
gallery.description: The tranquil stone pillared corridors and sacred teertham pond where pilgrims take holy ablutions.

gallery.title: Daily Annadhanam Hall (Free Food Seva)
gallery.description: Pilgrims enjoying hot consecrated satvik prasadam meals served daily in the spacious trust dining hall.
